# PR #212 review

## Major — dedicated Storybook fallback job duplicates CI setup

- **Owner:** `.github/workflows/verify.yml`
- **Problem:** the corrected topology removed the Storybook producer barrier, but the verifier-owned fallback proof is still hosted in a dedicated `storybook-build` GitHub Actions job. On ordinary changes where behavior or visual proof is selected, the verifier correctly skips the fallback build, yet GitHub still provisions a runner, checks out the repository, restores the pnpm cache, and installs dependencies solely to discover that there is no check to run.
- **Evidence:** [current workflow](https://github.com/Mioframe/mioframe/blob/79c75efe559024367a94f1597144fabb2be78da3/.github/workflows/verify.yml); [exact-head fallback job](https://github.com/Mioframe/mioframe/actions/runs/32288734556/job/96184531350) completed only after the full job setup and then reported `storybook-build: skipped (CI fallback: a self-contained Storybook browser lane already supplies the static build prerequisite)`. The same exact-head run proves the independent browser topology works: [behavior](https://github.com/Mioframe/mioframe/actions/runs/32288734556/job/96184531326) and [visual](https://github.com/Mioframe/mioframe/actions/runs/32288734556/job/96184531628) started directly after `autofix` and built their own Storybook.
- **Basis:** [testing architecture](https://github.com/Mioframe/mioframe/blob/79c75efe559024367a94f1597144fabb2be78da3/docs/testing/architecture.md) requires minimizing aggregate executions/resources, eliminating or deduplicating repeated setup before adding parallelism, and using parallelism only for irreducible work whose overhead is justified.
- **Risk:** every affected workflow pays an unnecessary runner/setup/install cycle and carries an extra job/dependency surface even when the fallback has no work. This is avoidable complexity in a PR whose purpose is verification cost reduction.
- **Required final state:** keep behavior, visual, and E2E independent after `autofix`, but execute the existing `STORYBOOK_BUILD_CI_FALLBACK=1` verifier invocation inside the already-provisioned `verification-static` job instead of a dedicated job. Remove the standalone fallback job and its aggregate dependency. Do not duplicate impact/path rules in YAML; the verifier must remain the decision owner. A build-only Storybook change must still execute exactly one real fallback build when neither browser lane is selected.
- **Verification:** verifier unit coverage must preserve the existing fallback truth table; exact-head CI must show no standalone no-op Storybook fallback job, behavior/visual must still start without a producer dependency, and a build-only fallback case must remain covered by deterministic verifier tests.
